_readme: Copy this file to net.json (same folder as index.html) and edit. Without net.json the game uses the built-in settings. Keys starting with _ are ignored. See docs/NETWORK.md.
_iceServers: Added to the built-in public STUN servers. Set "replaceDefaults": true next to iceServers to use only these.
_peer: Own signalling server (npx peerjs --port 9000). Remove the whole peer block to keep the public PeerJS cloud.
